info.description: The course includes 20 units. Every unit provides numerous grammatical sections that relate to the key grammatical point of the unit. The contents in 20 units offer students a solid foundation of grammatical knowledge such as sentence components; various sentence types such as simple and complex sentences, passive voice and conditional sentences; different types of clauses such as adjective clauses, reduced relative clauses, restrictive and non-restrictive clauses, non-finite clauses, subordinate clauses, etc.; different kinds of sentences such as simple and complex sentences, passive voice, conditional sentences, etc.
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Understand fundamental grammar points in English such as tenses, subject and verb agreement, nouns and noun phrases, pronouns, modal verbs, passive voice, noun clauses, adjective clauses, gerunds and infinitives, conjunctions, adverbial phrases, and relative clauses.

Apply the learned knowledge to speak and to write accurately and effectively, avoid grammatical errors; master and use technical terms of grammar description to have a critical evaluation and sharp criticism of certain articles; use various grammatical points to express thoughts clearly and grammatically in one’s native language.

Use various grammatical points to create writing and speaking products of high proficiency, know how to analyze sentences and clauses to enhance their language ability and to better their future profession.

Understand the importance of English grammar in order to improve language ability; recognize a close correlation between English grammar and other skills such as listening, speaking, reading and writing.
